column1: # REQ-027 seed replicates of the REQ-026 batch x kernel finding. SHA 365c392d, nodes qrv5913(A)+qzy15ow(B) (8xH100), torch 2.10.0+cu128.
# 6 arms = REQ-026 configs with `seed` changed only (checkpoints at +750 only). REQ-026 rows (seed 0) included for reference.
# Seed mechanism (measured): same b4x_mu0 config at seed=0 vs seed=1 to step 2125 -> 3.35602 vs 3.35584 (delta 1.8e-4, nondeterminism-level).
#   The harness reads the token stream SEQUENTIALLY (distributed_data_generator = contiguous tokens, no RNG shuffle), has no dropout, and the
#   fork LOADS params+optimizer -> `seed` only reseeds the (overwritten) param init, so it does NOT resample data order. The cross-seed spread
#   below is therefore accumulated run-to-run nondeterminism, not data-order resampling. All arms ARM_EXIT=0; base val@2000 = 3.4437 (all nodes, within noise).
